network_metadata.community_method: Native RAI weighted Louvain, seed 42, max_levels 5
network_metadata.betweenness_method: Native RAI exact UNWEIGHTED betweenness on the score-thresholded cohort topology

independent_validation.note: Louvain partitions can vary; verify coverage and weighted modularity, not identical labels

formula: Normalized strength = sqrt(sqrt(raw_strength)); raw_strength = 0.50 × min(effective_years / mean_career_years, 1) + 0.50 × min(effective_years / 10, 1)²; effective_years = unioned shared days × location × original recency bands / 365.25; friendship deferred
